about: Mix-and-match sections for flooring, carpet, tile, epoxy/garage-floor and concrete contractors, from 8 Dribbble full-page references (1–8.webp; shot links in _sources.json). Every mockup = one base STYLE + an ordered set of SECTIONS. Crops live in sections/<id>.jpg. Close-ups of floors being laid and finished rooms carry these pages: use the lead's real project photos first, then flooring stock. Square footage, years, ratings and service areas must come from FACTS.
